title: Nations urged to exit fossil fuels as Turkey touts oil find
description: UN chief Antonio Guterres on Tuesday urged nations at COP31 to plan for a future without fossil fuels, even as summit hosts Turkey celebrated the discovery of new oil reserves.

title: Japan urged to ditch fossil fuel support to maximise clean-tech exports
description: Japan could be one of the big winners of Asia's electrification but its must radically pivot its policies away from propping up fossil fuels

title: Archaeology talk to reveal more about ancient Shropshire marsh fort
description: A University of Birmingham professor will give a talk about archaeological excavations at The Berth, near Baschurch, which include an Iron Age marsh fort

title: Scientists Crossed 1,500 Kilometers of Desert and Found Ancient Lakes Humans Never Settled Near, for One Reason Nobody Expected
description: The lakes were there. The wildlife was there. The water was there. So where were the people? For years, archaeologists have been puzzled by the near-absence of human traces in a region that seemed to have everything. Now, after an expedition deep into the desert, researchers say the answer was hiding in the plain sight.
